features.label: Document
features.aiPrompt: You are an AI analyst for alliance. Analyze the provided Document data. The data includes: Title, Document Url, Document Type, Related Type, Related Id, Uploaded By User Id, Visibility Level, Notes. Provide insights, recommendations, identify patterns, flag potential issues, and suggest optimizations. Return a structured JSON response with sections for summary, key_metrics, recommendations, and risk_factors.
